# VS Code tasks

From `.vscode/tasks.json` (**Terminal > Run Task...**). Each feature gets a task that shows it working on a sample, and a section in `docs/validate-in-vscode.md` that says what to look for. The command shown is the Linux / macOS / WSL2 one; each task has a `windows` variant using `.venv\Scripts\python`.

| Task | Command |
| --- | --- |
| audit: 1. set up (venv + install) | `python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"` |
| audit: 2. tests (pytest) | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` |
| audit: 3. lint + type check | `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check . && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check . && .venv/bin/python -m mypy legacy_audit` |
| audit: 4. scan a sample | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit scan -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 5. scan all samples | `for s in struts-oracle-app spring-mvc-batch-app c-proc-batch cobol-cics-db2; do .venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit scan -c samples/$s/audit.yaml \|\| exit 1; done` |
| audit: 6. show dynamic SQL of the latest run | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_sql.py samples/${input:sample} --dynamic` |
| audit: 7. build and open the technical report | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit report --type tech --open -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 8. build the PowerPoint on a corporate template | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit report --type pptx --template ${input:template} -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 9. install Copilot files into a sample (init) | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit init samples/${input:sample}` |
| audit: 10. load demo enrichment and validate (Struts sample) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/demo_enrichment.py samples/struts-oracle-app ${input:demo}` |
| audit: 11. build management deck and PPTX | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit report --type all --open -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 12. query facts as Copilot does | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit facts ${input:kind} --limit 5 -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 13. start the GUI on a sample (legacy-audit serve) | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit serve --workspace samples/${input:sample}` |
| audit: 14. check installed tools (doctor) | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit doctor -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 15. performance test (generated estate) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/perf.py ${input:lines}` |
| audit: 16. load demo functional enrichment (Billing sample) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/demo_enrichment.py samples/spring-mvc-batch-app` |
| audit: 17. build and open the functional document | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit report --type functional --open -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 18. scan a sample without its scheduler inputs (Batch page) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/scan_without_inputs.py samples/${input:sample} --open` |
| audit: 19. test the AI model settings (enrich --check) | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit enrich --check -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 20. AI enrichment with the configured model (missing and stale stages) | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit enrich --stale -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 21. show components and the batch count | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_components.py samples/${input:sample}` |
| audit: 22. show lines of code by language and the integrations | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_loc_integrations.py samples/${input:sample}` |
| audit: 23. show all batches with what they do and when they run | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_batches.py samples/${input:sample}` |
| audit: 24. build and open the summary report (HTML and PowerPoint) | `.venv/bin/python -m legacy_audit report --type summary --open -c samples/${input:sample}/audit.yaml` |
| audit: 25. dependency vulnerabilities from both scanners (Billing demo) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_dependency_vulns.py samples/spring-mvc-batch-app --both --open` |
| audit: 26. Angular, Node.js and servers (Angular and Node sample) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_web_stack.py samples/angular-node-app --open` |
| audit: 27. Web services, REST and SOAP (web services sample) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_web_services.py samples/web-services-app --open` |
| audit: 28. Desktop and .NET apps (VB6, VB.NET, C#, Java Swing samples) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_desktop_stack.py samples/desktop-dotnet-app samples/java-swing-app --open` |
| audit: 29. AI enrichment for desktop, .NET, Angular and servers (demo) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_enrichment_coverage.py samples/desktop-dotnet-app samples/angular-node-app --open` |
| audit: 30. Migration targets: Spring Boot, WildFly on GKE, audit only (demo) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_targets.py samples/struts-oracle-app samples/angular-node-app --open` |
| audit: 31. show Maven modules and batches (multi-module sample) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_components.py samples/maven-multimodule-app` |
| audit: 32. PDF copies of the reports (sample app) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_pdfs.py samples/${input:sample} --open` |
| audit: 33. show component and integration grouping (sample app) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/show_grouping.py samples/${input:sample}` |
| audit: 34. scan error handling tests | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_linker.py -v -k "soap_services_on_one_host or failing_step or duplicate_ids"` |
| audit: 35. regenerate the developer reference (docs/developer/reference) | `.venv/bin/python scripts/gen_dev_reference.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_dev_reference.py -q` |

Inputs (pick lists the tasks ask for):

- `sample`: Sample application to scan (`struts-oracle-app`, `spring-mvc-batch-app`, `c-proc-batch`, `cobol-cics-db2`, `legacy-layout-app`, `angular-node-app`, `web-services-app`, `desktop-dotnet-app`, `java-swing-app`, `maven-multimodule-app`)
- `demo`: Load the demo enrichment as is, or with one wrong count (`--break`)
- `kind`: Kind of facts (`services`, `screens`, `sql_statements`, `integrations`, `batch_jobs`, `libraries`, `findings`, `components`)
- `lines`: Lines of code to generate for the performance test (`200000`, `500000`, `2000000`)
- `template`: Corporate PowerPoint template (`blue`, `orange`, `purple`)
